quote: NEVER use `any`.
statement: In all TypeScript files, code must not use the `any` type.

quote: Do NOT generate AI-like comments. Avoid narrating what the code does, explaining the obvious, or leaving tutorial-style commentary. Only add a comment when it captures genuinely non-obvious intent (a workaround, a gotcha, a "why" that the code can't express).
statement: In all source files, comments must not narrate what the code does or explain the obvious; comments are only allowed for non-obvious intent (workarounds, gotchas, why).

quote: Tests use Jest;
statement: In integration-tests/**, tests must be written with Jest.

quote: Use `medusaIntegrationTestRunner` from `@medusajs/test-utils`.
statement: In integration-tests/**, integration specs must use `medusaIntegrationTestRunner` from `@medusajs/test-utils`.

quote: Helpers for creating admin users, sellers, customers are in the `integration-tests/helpers`
statement: In integration-tests/**, specs should create admin users, sellers and customers through the helpers in `integration-tests/helpers` rather than ad hoc setup.

quote: Tests are splitted by different endpoint groups: `admin`, `vendor`, `store`. Example: `http/product/vendor/product.spec.ts`, `http/product/admin/product.spec.ts`.
statement: In integration-tests/http/**, spec files must be placed under per-surface folders (`<domain>/admin/`, `<domain>/vendor/`, `<domain>/store/`), e.g. `http/product/vendor/product.spec.ts`.

quote: Bug fixes and new features MUST include tests
statement: In all changes, bug fixes and new features must include tests.

quote: Follow module conventions from [`CLAUDE.md`](CLAUDE.md) and prefer the `packages/` workspace for new code.
statement: In the monorepo, new framework code should be placed in the `packages/` workspace rather than in `apps/`.

quote: Workflows support compensation (automatic rollback on failure) and expose hooks as extension points; steps return `StepResponse` and compose into a `WorkflowResponse`.
statement: In packages/core/src/workflows/**, steps must return a `StepResponse` and workflows must return a `WorkflowResponse`.

quote: **Modules never reference each other directly** — cross-module communication happens only through **links** and **workflows**.
statement: In packages/core/src/modules/**, a module must not import or reference another module directly; cross-module communication must go through links (`src/links`) and workflows.

quote: This is the only HTTP layer used by the dashboards.
statement: In packages/admin, packages/vendor and dashboard apps, HTTP calls must go through `@mercurjs/client` (`createClient` proxy) and no other HTTP layer.

quote: Arithmetic uses BigNumber.
statement: In commission code (packages/core commission module/workflows), money arithmetic must use BigNumber (MathBN) rather than plain JS number arithmetic.

quote: Steps and subscribers resolve the module as `IPayoutModuleService` from `@mercurjs/types`.
statement: In packages/core and plugins, steps and subscribers must resolve the payout module typed as `IPayoutModuleService` from `@mercurjs/types`.

quote: **Rule:** any new cross-dashboard primitive belongs in `dashboard-shared`. Page-specific composites stay in the consuming package.
statement: In the dashboards, a new primitive used by both admin and vendor must live in `packages/dashboard-shared`; page-specific composites stay in the consuming package.

quote: Library only. No pages, no routes, no providers, no i18n. Built with `tsup`, re-exports everything from `src/index.ts`.
statement: In packages/dashboard-shared, code must not contain pages, routes, providers or i18n configuration; it is a library that re-exports from `src/index.ts`.

quote: Each leaf is a `lazy()` import of a page module. Pages export a `Component` (and optionally `loader`, `Breadcrumb`, `ErrorBoundary`).
statement: In packages/{admin,vendor}/src/get-route-map.tsx, each route leaf must be a `lazy()` import of a page module that exports `Component` (optionally `loader`, `Breadcrumb`, `ErrorBoundary`).

quote:
src/pages/<domain>/
  index.ts                              barrel that re-exports each sub-page module
  common/                               cross-page hooks, types, utils, shared subcomponents
statement: In packages/{admin,vendor}/src/pages/<domain>/, each domain folder must have an `index.ts` barrel, a `common/` folder for shared hooks/utils, and `<domain>-list/`, `<domain>-detail/`, `<domain>-create/`, `<domain>-edit/` subfolders with `<domain>-<page>.tsx` files.

quote:
breadcrumb.tsx                      Breadcrumb component
    loader.ts                           react-router data loader
statement: In packages/{admin,vendor}/src/pages/<domain>/<domain>-detail/, the detail page must provide `breadcrumb.tsx` and a react-router `loader.ts` alongside `<domain>-detail.tsx`.

quote:
create-<domain>-<tab>.tsx         One file per tab, exports Root with _tabMeta
      schema.ts                         Zod schema + inferred type
statement: In packages/{admin,vendor}/src/pages/**/<domain>-create/components/create-<domain>-form/, each tab must be its own `create-<domain>-<tab>.tsx` file exporting a `Root` with `_tabMeta`, and the Zod schema must live in `schema.ts`.

quote: Prefer the admin-style convention (`category-list/`, `category-detail/`) for new pages; both styles are accepted in vendor until a migration sweep aligns them.
statement: In packages/vendor/src/pages/**, new pages should use the admin-style folders (`<domain>-list/`, `<domain>-detail/`, `components/`) rather than `_components/` and `[id]/`.

quote: Every page is also exported as a **Compound Component**: a `Root` is combined with named subparts via `Object.assign(Root, { Header, HeaderTitle, ... })`.
statement: In packages/{admin,vendor}/src/pages/**, every page must be exported as a compound component built with `Object.assign(Root, { Header, HeaderTitle, ... })`.

quote: The Root pattern uses `Children.count(children) > 0 ? children : <DefaultContent />` so the page renders defaults when used unchanged and exposes every part for overrides.
statement: In packages/{admin,vendor}/src/pages/**, a page `Root` must render `Children.count(children) > 0 ? children : <DefaultContent />`.

quote: All pages mount inside one of two layouts (`components/layout/pages` locally, or `@mercurjs/dashboard-shared`):
statement: In dashboard pages, page content must mount inside `SingleColumnPage` (lists, settings, simple detail) or `TwoColumnPage` (detail with sidebar).

quote: Exactly **two children** required: `<TwoColumnPage.Main />` and `<TwoColumnPage.Sidebar />`.
statement: In dashboard detail pages, `TwoColumnPage` must have exactly two children: `TwoColumnPage.Main` and `TwoColumnPage.Sidebar`.

quote: Pass `data={entity}` whenever these flags are on — there is a dev-mode warning if you forget.
statement: In dashboard pages, when `showJSON` or `showMetadata` is set on a page layout, `data={entity}` must also be passed.

quote: Every section inside a page is wrapped in `Container` from `@medusajs/ui` with two consistent classes:
statement: In dashboard pages, every section must be a `Container` from `@medusajs/ui` with `className="divide-y p-0"`.

quote: Header row: `flex items-center justify-between px-6 py-4` with `<Heading>` on the left and an `ActionMenu` / `Button` cluster on the right.
statement: In dashboard sections, the header row must use `flex items-center justify-between px-6 py-4` with a `<Heading>` on the left and actions on the right; each row uses `px-6 py-4`.

quote: For label/value rows prefer `SectionRow` (`grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 px-6 py-4` with `text-ui-fg-subtle`), or inline grids for one-off rows.
statement: In dashboard sections, label/value rows should use the `SectionRow` component.

quote: **Never** use raw `Controller` — always go through `Form.Field`.
statement: In dashboard forms, code must not use react-hook-form `Controller` directly; fields must go through `Form.Field`.

quote: Wrap every field in `<Form.Item>` so error and label ids are wired through context.
statement: In dashboard forms, every `Form.Field` render must wrap its content in `<Form.Item>` with `Form.Label`, `Form.Control` and `Form.ErrorMessage`.

quote: `Form.ErrorMessage` reads the field error from RHF automatically — never render error text manually.
statement: In dashboard forms, field error text must not be rendered manually; use `Form.ErrorMessage`.

quote: Use `Form.Hint` for help text below the input (uses `<Hint>` from `@medusajs/ui`).
statement: In dashboard forms, help text below an input should use `Form.Hint`.

quote: For selects, destructure `{ ref, onChange, ...field }` and pass `onValueChange={onChange}`; pass `dir={useDocumentDirection()}` for RTL.
statement: In dashboard forms, `Select` fields must destructure `{ ref, onChange, ...field }`, pass `onValueChange={onChange}` and `dir={useDocumentDirection()}`.

quote: Wrap the form element in `<KeyboundForm>` (from `components/utilities/keybound-form`) so Cmd/Ctrl+Enter submits.
statement: In dashboard forms, the form element must be wrapped in `<KeyboundForm>` rather than a raw `<form>`.

quote: One Zod schema per form, exported alongside the form (`schema.ts` or co-located).
statement: In dashboard forms, each form must have one exported Zod schema in `schema.ts` or co-located with the form.

quote: Use `zodResolver(schema)` and infer the form type with `z.infer<typeof Schema>`.
statement: In dashboard forms, `useForm` must use `zodResolver(schema)` and the form type must be `z.infer<typeof Schema>`.

quote: For nullable / optional values pass through `transformNullableFormData` / `transformNullableFormNumber` (`lib/form-helpers.ts`) before calling the mutation.
statement: In dashboard forms, nullable/optional values must pass through `transformNullableFormData` / `transformNullableFormNumber` before calling the mutation.

quote: Wrap form bodies in `flex w-full max-w-[720px] flex-col gap-y-8` for tab content. For drawer bodies use `flex flex-col gap-y-4`.
statement: In dashboard forms, tab content bodies must use `flex w-full max-w-[720px] flex-col gap-y-8` and drawer bodies `flex flex-col gap-y-4`.

quote: For toggles use `SwitchBox` (`components/common/switch-box`) which already adds the card styling
statement: In dashboard forms, toggle rows should use `SwitchBox` rather than a hand-styled `Switch`.

quote: Create pages live behind a routed full-screen modal:
statement: In dashboard create pages, the page must be hosted in `RouteFocusModal`, and multi-step creates must use `TabbedForm`.

quote: Each tab is a component whose `Root` carries `Root._tabMeta = defineTabMeta<Schema>({ id, labelKey, validationFields, isVisible? })`.
statement: In `TabbedForm` create flows, each tab component's `Root` must set `Root._tabMeta = defineTabMeta<Schema>({ id, labelKey, validationFields })`.

quote: `TabbedForm.Tab` is the bare layout primitive; prefer typed tab components with `_tabMeta`.
statement: In `TabbedForm` create flows, typed tab components with `_tabMeta` should be preferred over bare `TabbedForm.Tab`.

quote: Quick edits live in a side drawer:
statement: In dashboard edit pages, the page must be hosted in `RouteDrawer` with the form in `RouteDrawer.Form` + `KeyboundForm`, and a footer with secondary Cancel (`RouteDrawer.Close`) and primary Save with `isLoading={isPending}`.

quote: Always gate the form behind `ready = !isPending && !!entity` so the drawer is empty until data is loaded.
statement: In dashboard edit drawers, the edit form must only render when `ready = !isPending && !!entity`.

quote: Use `useRouteModal().handleSuccess(path?)` inside `onSuccess` to close the modal and (optionally) navigate.
statement: In dashboard route modals/drawers, the mutation `onSuccess` must call `useRouteModal().handleSuccess(path?)` to close and navigate.

quote: Throw render-time errors (`if (isError) throw error`) so `ErrorBoundary` catches them.
statement: In dashboard pages using query hooks, components must `if (isError) throw error` so the `ErrorBoundary` catches it.
scope: dashboard page components using query hooks

quote: Build columns with `createColumnHelper<Row>()` and an `actions` display column that renders `<ActionMenu>`.
statement: In dashboard list tables, columns must be built with `createColumnHelper<Row>()` and include an `actions` display column rendering `<ActionMenu>`.

quote: For row navigation, pass `navigateTo={(row) => row.id}` so clicking a row enters the detail route.
statement: In dashboard list tables, row navigation must be configured via `navigateTo={(row) => row.id}` on the DataTable.

quote: Standard `PAGE_SIZE = 20`.
statement: In dashboard list tables, the page size must be `PAGE_SIZE = 20`.

quote: Use `keepPreviousData` from TanStack Query for smooth pagination.
statement: In dashboard list query hooks, paginated queries must use `keepPreviousData` from TanStack Query.

quote: Filters / search are wired through the `useXTableQuery` hook (returns `{ raw, searchParams }`).
statement: In dashboard list tables, filters and search must be wired through a `use<Domain>TableQuery` hook returning `{ raw, searchParams }`.

quote: Use the two variants from `components/common/empty-table-content` (or `@mercurjs/dashboard-shared`):
statement: In dashboard tables, empty states must use `<NoResults />` (filtered, no matches) or `<NoRecords />` (no records yet).

quote: `components/common/action-menu` is the only acceptable way to render a row or section action menu:
statement: In dashboard pages, row and section action menus must be rendered with `ActionMenu`; hand-built dropdowns are not allowed.

quote: Convention: edit/navigation actions first; destructive actions last in their own group.
statement: In `ActionMenu` groups, edit/navigation actions must come first and destructive actions last in their own group.

quote: Provide `disabled` + `disabledTooltip` instead of hiding actions when context requires.
statement: In `ActionMenu` actions, unavailable actions should be shown with `disabled` + `disabledTooltip` rather than hidden.

quote: Encapsulate destructive actions in a `use-delete-<entity>-action.tsx` hook under `pages/<domain>/common/hooks/`.
statement: In dashboard pages, destructive actions must be encapsulated in a `use-delete-<entity>-action.tsx` hook under `pages/<domain>/common/hooks/`.

quote: Calls `usePrompt()` from `@medusajs/ui` with i18n `title`, `description`, `confirmText`, `cancelText`.
statement: In delete-action hooks, the hook must call `usePrompt()` from `@medusajs/ui` with translated title/description/confirmText/cancelText, then the mutation, then `toast.success`/`toast.error`, then navigate back.

quote: This is the only sanctioned destructive-action pattern; never inline a confirmation modal.
statement: In dashboard pages, confirmation modals for destructive actions must not be inlined; use the delete-action hook with `usePrompt()`.

quote: All HTTP traffic goes through the typed SDK: `sdk` (and `fetchQuery` for the few edge cases) live in `lib/client`. **Never call `fetch` directly from a page.**
statement: In dashboard pages, code must not call `fetch` directly; all HTTP must go through the typed `sdk` from `lib/client`.

quote: | `@mercurjs/admin`  | `sdk.admin.*`  |
statement: In packages/admin, API calls must use the `sdk.admin.*` namespace; in packages/vendor, `sdk.vendor.*`.

quote: Inputs/outputs come from `InferClientInput` / `InferClientOutput` (`@mercurjs/client`). Errors are `ClientError` from `@mercurjs/client`.
statement: In dashboard data hooks, request/response types must come from `InferClientInput` / `InferClientOutput` and errors typed as `ClientError` from `@mercurjs/client`.

quote: One file per backend domain. Each file:
statement: In packages/{admin,vendor}/src/hooks/api/<domain>.tsx, each domain file must create `const xQueryKeys = queryKeysFactory("x")` and expose `useX`, `useXList` and `useCreate/Update/DeleteX` hooks.

quote: Inside mutations, invalidate the right keys via `queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: xQueryKeys.lists() })` (or `details()`/`detail(id)`), and forward `onSuccess` through to the caller.
statement: In dashboard mutation hooks, mutations must invalidate `lists()` / `details()` / `detail(id)` query keys and forward `onSuccess` to the caller.

quote: `queryKeysFactory` from `@mercurjs/dashboard-shared` (or local `lib/query-key-factory.ts`) is the standard shape: `all / lists() / list(query) / details() / detail(id, query?)`. Use it for any new domain.
statement: In dashboard data hooks, query keys for any new domain must be built with `queryKeysFactory`.

quote: For initial data, page detail components use a `loader.ts` (react-router data loader) and pass the result to the hook via `initialData`.
statement: In dashboard detail pages, initial data should come from a `loader.ts` and be passed to the query hook via `initialData`.

quote: Every user-facing string goes through `useTranslation()` / `t(key)`.
statement: In dashboard UI code, every user-facing string must go through `useTranslation()` / `t(key)`; no literal UI strings.

quote: Translation files live in `src/i18n/translations/<lng>.json` per dashboard package (English is canonical; other locales are merged). `$schema.json` documents the shape and is enforced by tests in `i18n/translations/__tests__`.
statement: In packages/{admin,vendor}, translations must live in `src/i18n/translations/<lng>.json` and new keys must also be reflected in `$schema.json`.

quote: Tab labels use `labelKey` on `_tabMeta`; column headers, drawer titles, dialog copy all go through i18n keys.
statement: In dashboard UI, tab labels must use `labelKey` on `_tabMeta` and column headers, drawer titles and dialog copy must use i18n keys.

quote: For RTL support, always pass `dir={useDocumentDirection()}` to `Select`, `DropdownMenu`, etc.
statement: In dashboard UI, `Select`, `DropdownMenu` and similar menu components must receive `dir={useDocumentDirection()}`.

quote: ### `@medusajs/ui` is the only UI library
statement: In dashboard packages, UI components must come from `@medusajs/ui` (and `@mercurjs/dashboard-shared`); no other UI component library may be imported.

quote: For Radix primitives that Medusa UI does not re-export, use the bundled `radix-ui` package (e.g. `Label`, `Slot`).
statement: In dashboard packages, Radix primitives not re-exported by Medusa UI must be imported from the bundled `radix-ui` package (not individual `@radix-ui/*` packages).

quote: Never introduce a parallel UI library or restyle Medusa UI components with custom CSS. Custom variants belong on top of Medusa UI primitives.
statement: In dashboard packages, code must not restyle Medusa UI components with custom CSS or introduce a parallel UI library.

quote: Only icons from [`@medusajs/icons`](https://docs.medusajs.com/ui/icons/overview) are allowed
statement: In dashboard packages, icons must be imported only from `@medusajs/icons`.

quote: Do not bundle other icon packs (lucide, heroicons, custom SVGs) inside the dashboard packages.
statement: In dashboard packages, code must not import other icon packs (lucide, heroicons) or define custom SVG icon components.

quote: For row/section actions, place the icon inside the `ActionMenu` action descriptor (`icon: <PencilSquare />`).
statement: In `ActionMenu` row/section actions, each icon must be passed via the action descriptor's `icon` prop.

quote: Use only the [Medusa UI color tokens](https://docs.medusajs.com/ui/colors/overview). Never write hex colors, `rgb(...)`, or palette names.
statement: In dashboard UI code, colors must use Medusa UI tokens (`bg-ui-*`, `text-ui-fg-*`, `border-ui-border-*`, `shadow-elevation-*`); hex, `rgb(...)` and palette utilities (e.g. `text-gray-500`) are not allowed.

quote: Apply tokens via Tailwind utilities; `clx` (re-exported from `@medusajs/ui`) is the canonical helper for conditional class merging.
statement: In dashboard UI code, conditional class merging must use `clx` from `@medusajs/ui` (not clsx/classnames).

quote: Headings: `<Heading>` for section titles, `<Heading level="h2">` for sidebar sections; never style with raw `<h*>` elements.
statement: In dashboard UI code, headings must use `<Heading>` (`level="h2"` for sidebar sections); raw `<h1>`-`<h6>` elements must not be used.

quote: Body text: `<Text size="small" leading="compact">` for table-row text and section rows; `<Text size="xsmall">` for chips and breadcrumb segments; combine with `weight="plus"` for emphasized labels.
statement: In dashboard UI code, table-row/section text should use `<Text size="small" leading="compact">`, chips/breadcrumbs `<Text size="xsmall">`, emphasis `weight="plus"`.

quote:
Subtle copy: `` / `text-ui-fg-muted`. Never roll your own `

`.
statement:
In dashboard UI code, body/subtle copy must use `` with `text-ui-fg-subtle`/`text-ui-fg-muted`; raw `

` with palette classes must not be used.

quote: Section row vertical rhythm: `px-6 py-4`. Cluster gaps: `gap-x-2`, `gap-x-3`, `gap-x-4`. Outer page stack: `gap-y-3`.
statement: In dashboard UI code, spacing must use the documented scale (`px-6 py-4` rows, `gap-x-2/3/4` clusters, `gap-y-3` page stack, `gap-y-4` drawers, `gap-y-8` focus modals, `grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 md:grid-cols-2` field grids).

quote: Buttons inside compact toolbars and footers: `size="small"`.
statement: In dashboard toolbars and footers, `Button` must use `size="small"` with `primary` (save), `secondary` (cancel/nav) or `transparent` variants.

quote: Use `StatusBadge` with the helper color/label utilities in `pages/<domain>/common/utils.ts` (`getIsActiveProps`, `getIsInternalProps`, etc.). Place badges in the section header row to the right of the title, before the `ActionMenu`.
statement: In dashboard sections, status must be rendered with `StatusBadge` using color/label helpers from `pages/<domain>/common/utils.ts`, placed in the header row before the `ActionMenu`.

quote: Use `Skeleton` (`components/common/skeleton`) for placeholders. For detail pages, the corresponding `TwoColumnPageSkeleton` mirrors the section count so the layout doesn't jump.
statement: In dashboard pages, loading placeholders must use `Skeleton` (detail pages: `TwoColumnPageSkeleton`).

quote: Every interactive element in a list, header, action, form, or modal should carry `data-testid` (e.g. `category-create-form-name-input`, `sidebar-header-dropdown-trigger`). Use kebab-case scoped to the page/section.
statement: In dashboard UI code, every interactive element (buttons, inputs, headings, dropdown items) must carry a kebab-case `data-testid` scoped to the page/section.

quote: Add new keys to `src/i18n/translations/en.json` first.
statement: In packages/{admin,vendor}, new translation keys must be added to `src/i18n/translations/en.json` under the domain namespace.

quote: | A new TanStack Query hook                                                  | `packages/<dashboard>/src/hooks/api/<domain>.tsx`                            |
statement: In dashboard packages, TanStack Query hooks must live in `packages/<dashboard>/src/hooks/api/<domain>.tsx`; helpers shared by multiple pages in `src/lib/`.

quote: If the same primitive would land in both `packages/admin` and `packages/vendor`, prefer landing it once in `@mercurjs/dashboard-shared` and importing it from the consuming dashboards.
statement: In dashboard packages, a primitive duplicated in both admin and vendor should instead be placed once in `@mercurjs/dashboard-shared` and imported.

quote: **This project uses ONLY `@medusajs/icons`.** Do not install or import icons from any other library (`lucide-react`, `react-icons`, `heroicons`, `phosphor`, Material Icons, inline SVGs from random sources, etc.).
statement: In all UI code, icons must be imported only from `@medusajs/icons`; `lucide-react`, `react-icons`, `heroicons`, `phosphor` etc. must not be imported.

quote: do not add a new dependency, and do not hand-roll an SVG component.
statement: In UI code, missing icons must not be replaced with hand-rolled SVG components; pick the closest `@medusajs/icons` match.

quote: Use Tailwind/Medusa UI color tokens (`text-ui-fg-base`, `text-ui-fg-subtle`, `text-ui-fg-muted`, `text-ui-tag-red-icon`, etc.) for color — do not pass hex codes.
statement: In UI code, icon colors must be set with Medusa UI token classes; hex colors must not be passed to icons.

quote: **Use `Mini`/`Micro` variants only inside dense UI** (tables, inline labels, badges). Default size for buttons and menus.
statement: In UI code, `Mini`/`Micro` icon variants should only be used inside dense UI (tables, inline labels, badges); buttons and menus use default size.

quote: Don't inline raw `<svg>` markup unless you're rendering user-uploaded content.
statement: In UI code, raw `<svg>` markup must not be inlined except for user-uploaded content.

quote: Don't override icon size with hardcoded `width="24"` — use Tailwind size classes (`size-4`, `size-5`) or wrap in a sized container.
statement: In UI code, icon size must not be set with hardcoded `width`/`height` props; use Tailwind size classes or a sized container.

quote: **Mercur rule:** never add those options to cart, offer, pricing, or listing workflows.
statement: In cart, offer, pricing and listing workflows, `createWorkflow` must not set `retentionTime`, `idempotent`, `timeout`, `retryInterval`, `store` or `async` steps.

quote: Do not pass deterministic `transactionId`s on high-frequency routes
statement: In API route handlers on high-frequency routes, workflow runs must not pass a deterministic `transactionId`.

quote: **Mercur rule:** seller lookup, commission rule resolution, and payout reads that do not depend on each other go in one `parallelize`.
statement: In Mercur workflows, independent steps (seller lookup, commission rule resolution, payout reads) must be grouped in one `parallelize(...)`.

quote: Every step returns early on empty input (30+ examples in `cart/steps`).
statement: In workflow steps, every step must return early on empty input.

quote: **Mercur rule:** use `acquireLockStep` on `cart_id` in split-order completion with the same values. Lock inventory per inventory item (`reserve-inventory.ts:88`), never per seller or globally.
statement: In split-order completion workflows, `acquireLockStep` must lock on `cart_id` (timeout 30, ttl 120); inventory locks must be per inventory item, never per seller or global.

quote: **Mercur rule:** define per-purpose field constants, accept a preloaded entity in sub-workflows, use `Map` lookups in `transform`, and return several fields from one `transform` since results are memoized per transaction.
statement: In Mercur workflows, query fields should be per-purpose constants, sub-workflows should accept a preloaded entity, and `transform` lookups should use `Map`.

quote: **Mercur rule:** pass `{ id, ...data }[]` to module update methods. Never selector-per-row.
statement: In Mercur steps and services, module update methods must be called with a `{ id, ...data }[]` array, never one selector per row.

quote: **Mercur rule:** vendor CSV import/export, payout batches, and reindex use async background steps with 50 to 1000 item chunks. Never on cart paths.
statement: In import/export, payout batch and reindex workflows, long work must use `async: true` background steps with 50-1000 item chunks; async steps must never be used on cart paths.

quote: **Mercur rule:** Mercur link tables (seller-product, seller-order, offer links) need explicit `Link<Name>:list:*` tags or cached results go stale.
statement: In cached `useQueryGraphStep` queries touching Mercur link tables, explicit `Link<Name>:list:*` cache tags must be provided.

quote: **Mercur rule:** one `query.graph` with explicit `fields`, never a loop over sellers calling services.
statement: In Mercur backend code, data must be read with one `query.graph` with explicit `fields`, never by looping over sellers calling services.

quote: Do not expand unbounded one-to-many links (seller to products) in list views. Pass only `take` for internal lookups to avoid the COUNT.
statement: In list routes, `query.graph` must not expand unbounded one-to-many links (e.g. seller to products); internal lookups should pass only `take` (no `skip`).
scope: packages/**/src/api/** list routes and internal lookups

quote: **Mercur rule:** keep every Mercur module on the shared connection (no `database.clientUrl`), use `model.define`, and filter only on persisted columns.
statement: In Mercur modules, models must use `model.define`, modules must not configure `database.clientUrl`, and filters must only target persisted columns.

quote: **Mercur rule:** thread `@MedusaContext() sharedContext` through every nested service call. Use bulk `create`/`update` arrays and `upsertWithReplace` for vendor imports. Raw knex is acceptable for aggregates.
statement: In Mercur module services, every nested service call must receive the `@MedusaContext() sharedContext`; bulk create/update arrays and `upsertWithReplace` should be used for imports.

quote: **Mercur rule:** declare composite indexes for every filter combination used on list routes (`seller_id + status`, `seller_id + created_at`, offer `seller_id + sku`).
statement: In Mercur data models, composite indexes must be declared for every filter combination used on list routes (e.g. `seller_id + status`, `seller_id + created_at`).

quote: Any raw SQL must include `deleted_at IS NULL` or the partial indexes are skipped.
statement: In Mercur backend code, any raw SQL query must include a `deleted_at IS NULL` condition.

quote: Pass the pricing context through `QueryContext(req.pricingContext)` on `variants.calculated_price`. Never call `calculatePrices` per variant. Keep the context under 10 keys.
statement: In Mercur pricing reads, the pricing context must be passed through `QueryContext(req.pricingContext)` on `variants.calculated_price`; `calculatePrices` must never be called per variant.

quote: **Mercur rule:** mark the seller-product link `filterable` so Seller is ingested and seller filtering stays inside the index. Accept estimated counts. Entity IDs must be ULIDs for keyset sync.
statement: In packages/core/src/links, the seller-product link must be marked `filterable`, and entity ids must be ULIDs.

quote: **Mercur rule:** set `pool: { min: 2, max: 20 }` per process and size `(servers + workers) * max` within Postgres or PgBouncer limits.
statement: In medusa-config, `databaseDriverOptions.pool` should be set to `{ min: 2, max: 20 }` per process.

quote: **Mercur rule:** subscribers must handle `id: string[]`. Emit from workflows with `emitEventStep` so events are dropped on rollback. Emit arrays in one call.
statement: In Mercur subscribers, handlers must accept `id: string[]` payloads; events must be emitted from workflows with `emitEventStep`, emitting arrays in one call.

quote: **Mercur rule:** pass `{ cache: { enable: true }, locale }` on seller and product listing routes, as the core store products route does.
statement: In seller and product listing routes, `query.graph` must be called with `{ cache: { enable: true }, locale }`.

quote: Emit Mercur module events as `seller.updated`, `commission_rate.updated` with `{ id }` so Seller entries invalidate. Always select `id` in cached queries.
statement: In Mercur modules, events must be named `<entity>.<op>` (e.g. `seller.updated`) with `{ id }` payloads, and cached queries must always select `id`.

quote: Wrap commission rule resolution and seller shipping aggregation in `useCache`. Never mutate cached results in place
statement: In Mercur backend code, commission rule resolution and seller shipping aggregation should be wrapped in `useCache`, and cached results must never be mutated in place.

quote: Never do heavy work in `onApplicationStart` without checking `worker_mode !== "server"`.
statement: In module `onApplicationStart` hooks, heavy work must be guarded by a `worker_mode !== "server"` check.

quote: Add `.max(100)` to Mercur find-params `limit`. Use `allowFields(...)` instead of widening core allowlists.
statement: In Mercur route validators, find-params `limit` must have `.max(100)`, and field allowlists must be extended with `allowFields(...)` rather than widening core allowlists; `/vendor/*` routes need a middleware setting the relations limit.

quote: Vendor product lists must use curated fields, never the `*`-relation defaults.
statement: In vendor product list routes and queries, curated field lists must be used, never `*`-relation defaults.

quote: **Mercur rule:** reuse `normalizeDataForContext`, `setPricingContext`, and `setTaxContext` from `@medusajs/medusa/api/utils/middlewares`.
statement: In seller-scoped listing middlewares, code should reuse `normalizeDataForContext`, `setPricingContext` and `setTaxContext` from `@medusajs/medusa/api/utils/middlewares` rather than reimplementing them.

quote: Each module is a self-contained Medusa module with `index.ts` calling `Module(MercurModules.<NAME>, { service, loaders? })`.
statement: In packages/core/src/modules/<name>/index.ts, the module must be registered with `Module(MercurModules.<NAME>, { service, loaders? })`.

quote: `service.ts` extends `MedusaService({ ...Models })` and adds custom methods with `@InjectManager` / `@InjectTransactionManager`.
statement: In packages/core/src/modules/*/service.ts, the service must extend `MedusaService({ ...Models })` and custom methods must use `@InjectManager` / `@InjectTransactionManager`.

quote: Module identifier strings come from `MercurModules` in `@mercurjs/types`.
statement: In packages/core, module identifier strings must come from the `MercurModules` enum in `@mercurjs/types`, not string literals.

quote: Repositories (e.g. `OrderGroupRepository`) are used when a model needs queries beyond what `MedusaService` generates.
statement: In packages/core modules, custom repositories should only be added when a model needs queries beyond what `MedusaService` generates.

quote: They use `defineLink(...)` to wire Mercur tables to Medusa core tables (and to each other) without breaking module isolation.
statement: In packages/core/src/links/, relationships between Mercur and Medusa entities must be declared with `defineLink(...)` in `*-link.ts` files.

quote:
`route.ts` -- exports `GET` / `POST` / `PUT` / `DELETE` handlers.
- `validators.ts` -- Zod schemas for body/params/query.
- `query-config.ts` -- default fields & pagination for `query.graph`
statement: In packages/core/src/api/** endpoint directories, handlers go in `route.ts`, Zod schemas in `validators.ts`, default fields/pagination in `query-config.ts`, private helpers in `helpers.ts`, and path params in `[id]/` subdirectories.

quote: `middlewares.ts` -- route-specific middleware bindings exported as a named array (e.g. `vendorProductsMiddlewares`).
statement: In packages/core/src/api/**/middlewares.ts, route middleware bindings must be exported as a named array called `<scope><Resource>Middlewares` (e.g. `vendorProductsMiddlewares`).

quote: Handlers typically resolve `ContainerRegistrationKeys.QUERY` for reads and run a workflow for writes (e.g. `createProductsWorkflow`, `createSellersWorkflow`).
statement: In packages/core/src/api/**/route.ts, handlers should resolve `ContainerRegistrationKeys.QUERY` for reads and run a workflow for writes.

quote: Workflows are the canonical place for write operations. Each top-level folder groups workflows by entity, with `steps/` and `workflows/` subdirectories and a barrel `index.ts`. `src/workflows/index.ts` re-exports them all.
statement: In packages/core/src/workflows/<entity>/, workflows must be split into `steps/` and `workflows/` subdirectories with a barrel `index.ts`, all re-exported from `src/workflows/index.ts`.

quote: `events.ts` -- event name constants (`SellerWorkflowEvents`, `SellerMemberWorkflowEvents`, `MemberInviteWorkflowEvents`, `OrderGroupWorkflowEvents`).
statement: In packages/core workflows, event names must be referenced through the constants in `src/workflows/events.ts` (e.g. `SellerWorkflowEvents`), not string literals.

quote: `seller-context.ts` defines `SellerContext` and augments `express.Request` with an optional `seller_context` so handlers and middleware downstream of `ensureSellerMiddleware` can rely on `req.seller_context`.
statement: In packages/core vendor handlers and middleware, the acting seller must be read from `req.seller_context` (typed via `src/types/seller-context.ts`).

quote: Anything not re-exported through one of these barrels is considered internal and may move without notice.
statement: In packages/dashboard-shared, public components and hooks must be re-exported through `src/components/index.ts` / `src/hooks/index.ts` barrels from `src/index.ts`.

quote: Consumers should always import from the package root:
statement: In consumers of `@mercurjs/dashboard-shared`, imports must come from the package root `@mercurjs/dashboard-shared`, never from sub-paths or `dist/...`.

quote: Custom registry blocks (`@mercurjs/registry`) and any user-authored block packages import the primitives directly from `@mercurjs/dashboard-shared` — that is the supported public boundary for third-party extensions.
statement: In packages/registry blocks, dashboard primitives must be imported from `@mercurjs/dashboard-shared`.

quote: Build schemas with `zod` and resolve them via `@hookform/resolvers/zod`. Reusable shapes live in `lib/schemas.ts` (`AddressSchema`, `EmailSchema`, `TransferOwnershipSchema`).
statement: In dashboard forms, schemas must be built with `zod` and resolved via `@hookform/resolvers/zod`; address/email/transfer-ownership rules must reuse `AddressSchema`, `EmailSchema`, `TransferOwnershipSchema` from `lib/schemas.ts`.

quote: Composite forms — `AddressForm`, `EmailForm`, `MetadataForm` — accept a `control` from the parent RHF instance; never spawn an inner form.
statement: In dashboard forms, composite forms (`AddressForm`, `EmailForm`, `MetadataForm`) must receive the parent's `control` and must not create an inner `useForm`.

quote: Toggles use `SwitchBox` (already padded + card-styled). Country pickers use `CountrySelect` / `ProvinceSelect`. Slug fields use `HandleInput`.
statement: In dashboard forms, toggles must use `SwitchBox`, country pickers `CountrySelect` / `ProvinceSelect`, and slug fields `HandleInput`.

quote: Still used widely; marked `@deprecated`. New pages should not adopt it, but the contract is stable enough that migration is a per-page exercise.
statement: In new dashboard list pages, code should use the current `DataTable` (`components/data-table`) and not the deprecated `_DataTable`.

quote: Common cells live in `components/table/table-cells/common` (`TextCell`, `StatusCell`, `MoneyAmountCell`, `DateCell`, `CreatedAtCell`, `EmailCell`, `CodeCell`, `NameCell`, `PlaceholderCell`).
statement: In dashboard tables, column cells should use the shared cell primitives (`TextCell`, `StatusCell`, `MoneyAmountCell`, `DateCell`, ...).

quote: It is not a table replacement — only use it when the UX is "type into many cells, undo with Cmd+Z, paste a column from Excel".
statement: In dashboard pages, `DataGrid` must only be used for bulk-editable matrices, not as a table replacement; price columns use `createDataGridColumnHelper` / `createDataGridPriceColumns`.

quote: `ActionMenu` is the only sanctioned overflow / row-action menu.
statement: In dashboard UI, overflow and row-action menus must be `ActionMenu`.

quote: While data loads, render `SingleColumnPageSkeleton sections={n}` or `TwoColumnPageSkeleton mainSections={n} sidebarSections={n}` to match the eventual layout.
statement: In dashboard pages, loading states should render `SingleColumnPageSkeleton` / `TwoColumnPageSkeleton` (or `TableSkeleton` for tables) matching the final layout.

quote: Locale-aware date formatter built on `date-fns`. Use whenever you display dates so RTL/locale settings are honoured.
statement: In dashboard UI, displayed dates must be formatted with the `useDate` hook.

quote: Use it for every `useX` / `useXList` hook so invalidation lines up across the dashboards.
statement: In dashboard data hooks, every `useX` / `useXList` hook must build keys with `queryKeysFactory(globalKey)`.

quote: `getLocaleAmount`, `getDecimalDigits`, `getNativeSymbol`. Always use these instead of `Intl.NumberFormat` directly so locale + decimal places match the rest of the dashboards.
statement: In dashboard UI, currency formatting must use `getLocaleAmount` / `getDecimalDigits` / `getNativeSymbol` and must not call `Intl.NumberFormat` directly.

quote: **No routing or domain logic.** Everything here is presentation + form state + cache plumbing.
statement: In packages/dashboard-shared, code must not contain routing or domain/business logic.

quote: `react`, `react-dom`, and the SDK virtual modules (`virtual:mercur/config`, `virtual:mercur/routes`) are marked external — the package never bundles them.
statement: In packages/dashboard-shared build config, `react`, `react-dom` and `virtual:mercur/*` modules must be marked external.

quote: create `page.tsx` files under `src/routes`
statement: In apps/admin-test, custom admin pages must be `page.tsx` files under `src/routes`, with the file path controlling the route.

quote: export route config when the page should appear in navigation
statement: In apps/admin-test/src/routes, a page that appears in navigation must export a route config.

quote: Prefer existing local wrappers and `@medusajs/ui` before introducing new primitives or custom components.
statement: In apps/admin-test, UI should use existing wrappers and `@medusajs/ui` before introducing new primitives.

quote: Use i18n for user-facing strings instead of hardcoded copy.
statement: In apps/admin-test, user-facing strings must use i18n rather than hardcoded copy.

quote: Prefer typed API usage through shared Mercur client patterns.
statement: In apps/admin-test, API calls should use the typed Mercur client (`@mercurjs/client`).

quote: Preserve loading, error, empty, and success states when extending screens.
statement: In apps/admin-test screens, loading, error, empty and success states should be handled.

quote: create `page.tsx` files under `src/routes`
statement: In apps/vendor, custom vendor pages must be `page.tsx` files under `src/routes`, with the file path controlling the route.

quote: Prefer existing local wrappers and `@medusajs/ui` before adding lower-level primitives.
statement: In apps/vendor, UI should use existing wrappers and `@medusajs/ui` before adding lower-level primitives.

quote: Use i18n for user-facing strings.
statement: In apps/vendor, user-facing strings must use i18n.

quote: Prefer typed client access over ad hoc request code.
statement: In apps/vendor, requests should use the typed client rather than ad hoc request code (e.g. raw fetch).

quote: Preserve loading, empty, error, and success states when extending flows.
statement: In apps/vendor flows, loading, empty, error and success states should be handled.

quote: create `page.tsx` files under `src/routes`
statement: In templates/basic/apps/admin, custom admin pages must be `page.tsx` files under `src/routes`.

quote: Use i18n for user-facing strings instead of hardcoded copy.
statement: In templates/basic/apps/admin, user-facing strings must use i18n rather than hardcoded copy.

quote: Prefer typed API usage through shared Mercur client patterns.
statement: In templates/basic/apps/admin, API calls should use the typed Mercur client.

quote: create `page.tsx` files under `src/routes`
statement: In templates/basic/apps/vendor, custom vendor pages must be `page.tsx` files under `src/routes`.

quote: Use i18n for user-facing strings.
statement: In templates/basic/apps/vendor, user-facing strings must use i18n.

quote: Prefer typed client access over ad hoc request code.
statement: In templates/basic/apps/vendor, requests should use the typed client rather than ad hoc request code.

quote: If `src/` does not exist yet, create only the folders needed for the feature:
statement: In templates/basic/packages/api, backend code must live under `src/api`, `src/modules`, `src/workflows`, `src/links`, `src/subscribers`, `src/jobs` or `src/scripts`.

quote: Use a **link** when the feature defines a relationship across modules.
statement: In templates/basic/packages/api, relationships across modules must be defined as links (`src/links`), domain events handled by subscribers, scheduled work by jobs, and multi-step processes by workflows.

quote: A route does exactly this:
statement: In backend route handlers, a write route must only run one workflow with `{ id: req.params.id, ...req.validatedBody }`, refetch the entity with `req.queryConfig.fields`, and `res.json` it.

quote: The refetch helper lives in the resource's `helpers.ts`: `refetchEntity({ entity, idOrFilter, scope, fields })` from `@medusajs/framework/http`.
statement: In backend API routes, the refetch helper must live in the resource's `helpers.ts` and use `refetchEntity` from `@medusajs/framework/http`.

quote: Validation comes from `middlewares.ts`: `validateAndTransformBody` with a zod `.strict()` schema and `validateAndTransformQuery` with `query-config.ts` defaults. Fields lists go in `query-config.ts`, never inline in the route.
statement: In backend API routes, validation must be wired in `middlewares.ts` with `validateAndTransformBody` (zod `.strict()` schema) and `validateAndTransformQuery` (query-config defaults); field lists must be in `query-config.ts`, never inline in `route.ts`.

quote: **Not allowed in a route:** `createStep`/`createWorkflow`, `service.*` calls, lookups to resolve ids, branching on entity state, running two workflows, `throwOnError: false` to paper over a failure, or reading module options.
statement: In backend route files, code must not call `createStep`/`createWorkflow`, call module `service.*` methods, resolve ids via lookups, branch on entity state, run two workflows, pass `throwOnError: false`, or read module options.

quote: Webhook hook routes only emit an event (`medusa/src/api/hooks/payment/[provider]/route.ts`). The subscriber parses and runs the workflow by id
statement: In `src/api/hooks/**` webhook routes, the handler must only emit an event; parsing and running the workflow (by id) belongs in a subscriber.

quote: **Exports:** `export const xWorkflowId = "kebab-id"`, `export type XWorkflowInput`, `export const xWorkflow = createWorkflow(xWorkflowId, function (input) { ... })`, with a short JSDoc on what it does.
statement: In workflow files, code must export `xWorkflowId` (kebab-case string), `type XWorkflowInput`, and `xWorkflow = createWorkflow(xWorkflowId, function (input) {...})` with a short JSDoc.

quote: **Input:** takes ids and minimal values. The workflow loads what it needs. Don't pass data in only to forward it to an event; query it.
statement: In workflows, the input must take ids and minimal values rather than whole entities; data must not be passed in only to forward it to an event.

quote: **Loading:** use `useQueryGraphStep({ entity, fields, filters, options: { isList: false, throwIfKeyNotFound: true } }).config({ name: "unique-name" })`. Every repeated query step gets a unique `.config({ name })`.
statement: In workflows, data loading must use `useQueryGraphStep(...)` and every repeated query step must have a unique `.config({ name })`.

quote: **Branching and data:** branch with `when("named-condition", { deps }, fn).then(() => ...)`, and do calculations only in `transform`.
statement: In workflow composition functions, branching must use named `when("name", {deps}, fn).then(...)` and calculations must happen only inside `transform`.

quote: **No nested `when`:** a `when` inside another `when`'s `.then` breaks the outer one at load. Use sibling `when` blocks that return values, and `transform` over the possibly-undefined result.
statement: In workflow composition functions, a `when` must not be nested inside another `when`'s `.then`; use sibling `when` blocks.

quote: **Guard empty filters:** wrap a query in `when` if its `id: [...]` or `$or: [...]` filter could be empty.
statement: In workflows, a query whose `id: [...]` or `$or: [...]` filter could be empty must be wrapped in a `when` guard.

quote: **Validation:** `validate-*` steps throw `MedusaError` with the right type (`NOT_FOUND`, `NOT_ALLOWED`, `INVALID_DATA`, `CONFLICT`) and return `new StepResponse(void 0)`.
statement: In `validate-*` workflow steps, failures must throw `MedusaError` with a proper type (`NOT_FOUND`, `NOT_ALLOWED`, `INVALID_DATA`, `CONFLICT`) and success must return `new StepResponse(void 0)`.

quote: **Composition:** reuse Medusa steps (`createRemoteLinkStep`, `emitEventStep`, `useQueryGraphStep`) and Mercur steps, nest other workflows with `xWorkflow.runAsStep({ input })`, and expose extension points with `createHook`.
statement: In workflows, existing Medusa/Mercur steps must be reused, nested workflows invoked with `xWorkflow.runAsStep({ input })`, and extension points exposed with `createHook`.

quote: **Helpers:** pure helpers (no container, no IO) go in `workflows/<domain>/utils/` (like `core-flows/src/payment-collection/utils`). A helper that queries or writes is a step, not a util.
statement: In workflows, pure helpers (no container, no IO) must live in `workflows/<domain>/utils/`; helpers that query or write must be steps, not utils.

quote: One step per file in `steps/`, and the `steps/index.ts` barrel re-exports every file.
statement: In workflow `steps/` folders, each file must define exactly one step and `steps/index.ts` must re-export every step file.

quote: Export `xStepId` + `xStep = createStep(xStepId, invoke, compensate)`.
statement: In step files, code must export `xStepId` and `xStep = createStep(xStepId, invoke, compensate)`.

quote: One module call per step. Compensation restores exactly what the step changed: delete created rows, write back the previous values captured before the update.
statement: In workflow steps, each step must make one module call and its compensation must restore exactly what it changed.

quote: No compensation only when the effect can't be undone (money sent to a provider, a link a user already got). Say so in one comment, as Medusa does in `capture-payment.ts`.
statement: In workflow steps without a compensation function, a one-line comment must explain why the effect cannot be undone.

quote: Batch steps take arrays and tolerate `[]`.
statement: In batch workflow steps, input must be an array and the step must handle `[]` without failing.

quote: `class XModuleService extends MedusaService({ ...models })` gives generated CRUD (`createXs`, `updateXs`, `listXs`, ...). Custom methods use domain verbs that don't collide with the generated ones
statement: In module services, the class must be named `XModuleService` and extend `MedusaService({ ...models })`; custom methods must use domain verbs that do not collide with generated CRUD names.

quote: Public methods that write: `@InjectManager() @EmitEvents()` with `@MedusaContext() sharedContext?: Context`.
statement: In module services, public write methods must be decorated with `@InjectManager()` and `@EmitEvents()` and take a trailing `@MedusaContext() sharedContext?: Context`.

quote: Internal transactional writers: `protected async x_()` with `@InjectTransactionManager()`.
statement: In module services, internal transactional write methods must be `protected async x_()` (trailing underscore) decorated with `@InjectTransactionManager()`.

quote: Provider calls: `protected async xFromProvider_()`, outside the transaction, so a row lock (`knex(table).where("id", id).forUpdate()` after `SET LOCAL lock_timeout`) is never held across a network call.
statement: In module services, provider calls must be in `protected async xFromProvider_()` methods outside the transaction so no row lock is held across a network call.

quote: **No free functions or module-scope helpers** in the service file. Helpers become `protected` methods, and constants become `static readonly`.
statement: In module service files, there must be no free functions or module-scope helpers; helpers must be `protected` methods and constants `static readonly`; status derivation lives in the service, not `utils/`.

quote: Provider access goes through a provider service (`retrieveProvider` from the container). Optional provider methods are guarded.
statement: In module services, provider access must go through a provider service (`retrieveProvider`) and optional provider methods must be guarded before calling.

quote: Modules never import other modules. Cross-module data goes through links (`defineLink`) and workflows. Module migrations never touch other modules' tables.
statement: In modules, code must not import other modules, and module migrations must not touch other modules' tables.

quote: Links are created in workflows via `createRemoteLinkStep`, not with `link.create` inside a util.
statement: In backend code, links must be created in workflows via `createRemoteLinkStep`, not with `link.create` inside a util.

quote: A link alias that matches a relation name on the same module silently breaks resolution (e.g. `images` on ProductCategory).
statement: In link definitions, a link alias must not match an existing relation name on the same module.

quote: `fields` params: unprefixed fields replace route defaults; prefix with `+`/`-` to merge.
statement: In client/backend queries, `fields` entries meant to extend route defaults must be prefixed with `+` or `-`.
scope: fields params in client calls and queries

quote: Events: `emitEventStep({ eventName, data })` in the workflow, with names from `@mercurjs/types` constants.
statement: In workflows, events must be emitted with `emitEventStep({ eventName, data })` using event-name constants from `@mercurjs/types`.

quote: Overriding a core Medusa route's validation needs the route file **and** the middleware listed in `disableMedusaMiddlewares`.
statement: In route overrides of core Medusa routes, the override must include the route file and list the core middleware in `disableMedusaMiddlewares`.

quote: Integration specs use `medusaIntegrationTestRunner` and the `integration-tests/helpers`, split by `admin` / `vendor` / `store`. Use the `createVendorProduct` helper for products.
statement: In integration specs, products must be created with the `createVendorProduct` helper from `integration-tests/helpers`.

quote: A list is `SingleColumnPage` + `Container className="divide-y p-0"` + a header row (`flex items-center justify-between px-6 py-4`, `<Heading>` + short subtitle + actions) + `_DataTable` with `filters`, `pagination`, `navigateTo` and `noRecords`.
statement: In dashboard list pages, the table must be configured with `filters`, `pagination`, `navigateTo` and `noRecords`.

quote: A detail is `TwoColumnPage` with `Main` / `Sidebar`, `showJSON`, `WidgetZone`s, a status `Alert` at the top when there is a reason, and a general section whose header holds the title, a `StatusBadge` and an `ActionMenu`.
statement: In dashboard detail pages, `TwoColumnPage` must include `showJSON` and `WidgetZone`s, and the general section header must hold the title, a `StatusBadge` and an `ActionMenu`.

quote: **No page-level tabs, KPI/count strips or "job cards"** repeated across tabs. Related entities become nested sidebar items (`defineRouteConfig({ nested: "/parent" })`)
statement: In dashboard pages, page-level tabs and KPI/count strips must not be used; related entities must be nested sidebar items via `defineRouteConfig({ nested: "/parent" })`.

quote: **Don't duplicate core pages.** If core already shows an entity (payouts, payout accounts), a plugin adds a widget to that page's zone (`payouts.detail.side`, `payout_accounts.detail.side`, ...) instead of its own table.
statement: In plugin panels, entities already shown by core pages must be extended with a widget in that page's zone rather than a duplicate page or table.

quote: Use the shared pattern, not a hand-made card:
statement: In dashboard pages, links to another entity must use `SidebarLink` or a section row link (`text-ui-fg-subtle hover:text-ui-fg-base`), not a hand-made card.

quote: In a plugin, use a parallel route folder (`routes/x/@create/page.tsx`) so it opens over the list (`SingleColumnPage hasOutlet`).
statement: In plugin panels, create/edit drawers must be routed as parallel route folders (`routes/x/@create/page.tsx`) over a list rendered with `SingleColumnPage hasOutlet`.

quote: No `useState` forms and no raw `Drawer`.
statement: In dashboard and plugin panel forms, forms must use react-hook-form + `zodResolver`; `useState`-managed forms and raw `Drawer` must not be used.

quote: Entity pickers are a `Combobox` with search over the API, never a free-text id input.
statement: In dashboard forms, entity pickers must be a `Combobox` searching the API, never a free-text id input.

quote: Actions live in an `ActionMenu` with a `permission`, `disabled` and `disabledTooltip`.
statement: In dashboard `ActionMenu` actions, each action should carry `permission`, `disabled` and `disabledTooltip`.

quote: Queries return `{ ...data, ...rest }`, and mutations accept options and forward `onSuccess` after invalidating.
statement: In dashboard query hooks, query hooks must return `{ ...data, ...rest }` and mutation hooks must accept options and forward `onSuccess` after invalidating.

quote: Never spread `q: undefined` (or any undefined param) into a client query; spread it conditionally.
statement: In dashboard client queries, undefined params (e.g. `q: undefined`) must not be spread into the query; they must be added conditionally.

quote: Vendor product lists use `useProductTableQuery`'s curated fields. Adding `+field` to `GET /vendor/products` returns a 500.
statement: In vendor product lists, queries must use `useProductTableQuery`'s curated fields and must not add `+field` to `GET /vendor/products`.

quote: **Labels, not raw values.** Map status enums and provider codes (`requirements.past_due`, `rejected.fraud`) to sentences, and show names instead of ids.
statement: In dashboard UI, status enums and provider codes must be mapped to labels and names shown instead of ids; raw values must not be rendered.

quote: **Short copy.** Subtitles are one short clause. Empty states say what will appear, not how the system works. No "AI-ish" explanatory paragraphs.
statement: In dashboard UI copy, subtitles and empty states should be short and not explanatory paragraphs.

quote: **Strings go through i18n** in core panels: `en.json` + `$schema.json` together.
statement: In core panels, new strings must be added to both `en.json` and `$schema.json` together.

quote: Nav items for plugin routes are `type: "extension"` so the sidebar draws the bordered tile.
statement: In plugin panels, nav items for plugin routes must be `type: "extension"`, and brand icons must follow the Medusa extension-icon shape (15x15 square, brand fill, gradient overlay, 9x9 glyph).

quote: Only Medusa UI tokens (`text-ui-fg-*`, `bg-ui-bg-*`, `border-ui-border-*`, `shadow-elevation-*`) and only `@medusajs/icons`. Brand marks are the one exception, with a one-line comment saying so.
statement: In dashboard and plugin panel UI, only Medusa UI tokens and `@medusajs/icons` may be used; brand marks are the only exception and must carry a one-line comment saying so.

quote: `data-testid` goes on headings, inputs, buttons and menu triggers (kebab-case, scoped to the page).
statement: In dashboard and plugin panel UI, headings, inputs, buttons and menu triggers must have kebab-case page-scoped `data-testid`s.

quote: steps or workflows defined inside route files; several steps in one file; steps without ids or compensation where a rollback is possible
statement: In backend code, steps/workflows must not be defined inside route files, a file must not hold several steps, and steps must have ids and compensation where rollback is possible.

quote: money math outside `MathBN`, rounding, sign of reversals and debits
statement: In backend code, money arithmetic must use `MathBN`.

quote: N+1 queries and unbounded `take: null` lists on hot paths
statement: In backend hot paths, code must not issue N+1 queries or unbounded `take: null` list queries.

quote: vendor routes not scoped to `req.seller_context`, and admin/vendor routes missing `requirePermission`
statement: In backend admin and vendor routes, vendor routes must be scoped to `req.seller_context` and admin/vendor routes must apply `requirePermission`.

quote: webhook handlers trusting payloads without the provider's signature check
statement: In webhook handlers, payloads must be verified with the provider's signature check before being trusted.

quote: raw SQL / `raw()` with interpolated input, and prompt injection into any LLM call
statement: In backend code, raw SQL / `raw()` must not interpolate request input.

quote: unvalidated bodies (no zod `.strict()` validator) on new POST routes
statement: In backend POST routes, request bodies must be validated with a zod `.strict()` validator.

quote: comments that narrate what the code does, restate names, reference specs/tickets, or say "Mercur-specific"/"for robustness". Only external gotchas earn a comment.
statement: In all code, comments must not narrate code, restate names, reference specs/tickets or say "Mercur-specific"/"for robustness"; only external gotchas warrant comments.

quote: `any`, `as never`, `as unknown as` where a real type exists
statement: In TypeScript code, `any`, `as never` and `as unknown as` casts must not be used where a real type exists.

quote: names that don't match the Medusa vocabulary (`dispatch*`, `evaluate*`, `ensure*` where Medusa says `create`/`process`/`update`/`refetch`)
statement: In backend code, names must follow Medusa vocabulary (`create`/`process`/`update`/`refetch`) rather than `dispatch*`, `evaluate*`, `ensure*`.

quote: dead code, unused exports, compatibility shims nobody needs, abstractions with one caller
statement: In all code, dead code, unused exports, unneeded compatibility shims and single-caller abstractions should not be added.

quote: files over ~300 lines that mix concerns
statement: In all code, files should not exceed ~300 lines while mixing concerns.

quote: any mention of AI tools, Mirakl, "port of" or "the connector" in code, comments or docs
statement: In code and comments, there must be no mention of AI tools, Mirakl, "port of" or "the connector".

quote: **Never** introduce another component or icon library (no MUI, Chakra, Ant, Mantine, lucide, heroicons, react-icons, FontAwesome, styled-components, emotion).
statement: In dashboard packages, code must not import MUI, Chakra, Ant, Mantine, lucide, heroicons, react-icons, FontAwesome, styled-components or emotion.

quote: Never render raw `FocusModal` / `Drawer` from `@medusajs/ui` for a page's create/edit surface — use the `Route*` wrappers so nav-blocking and dirty prompts work.
statement: In dashboard create/edit pages, raw `FocusModal` / `Drawer` from `@medusajs/ui` must not be rendered; use `RouteFocusModal` / `RouteDrawer`.

quote: Never use raw `<input>`, `<textarea>`, `<select>`, or react-hook-form `<Controller>` directly — always the primitives above inside `Form.Field`.
statement: In dashboard forms, raw `<input>`, `<textarea>`, `<select>` elements and `<Controller>` must not be used; use Medusa UI/shared primitives inside `Form.Field`.

quote: Map the Figma element's role/emphasis to a variant here; do not restyle with `className`.
statement: In dashboard UI, Medusa UI component appearance must be chosen with variant/size props, not overridden via `className` (className-overriding Medusa UI components is forbidden).

quote: pull color/label from `pages/<domain>/common/utils.ts` helpers, don't hardcode
statement: In dashboard UI, `StatusBadge` color/label must come from `pages/<domain>/common/utils.ts` helpers, not hardcoded.

quote: Prefer these over arbitrary `mt-*`/`space-y-[...]` values.
statement: In dashboard UI, spacing should use the scale (`py-4`, `px-6`, `gap-y-3/4/8`) rather than arbitrary `mt-*` / `space-y-[...]` values.

quote: **Buttons**: don't hand-color buttons — use `Button` variants (`primary`, `secondary`, `transparent`, `danger`) and `IconButton`, which resolve to `--button-*` tokens.
statement: In dashboard UI, buttons must not be hand-colored; use `Button` variants or `IconButton`.

quote: Focus rings via `shadow-borders-focus`, not custom outlines.
statement: In dashboard UI, focus rings must use `shadow-borders-focus`, not custom outlines.

quote: Light/dark are handled automatically by the token — never fork colors per theme.
statement: In dashboard UI, colors must not be forked per theme (e.g. `dark:` color overrides); rely on Medusa UI tokens.

quote: **Don't**: a `Container` for a section without `p-0` (you'll get default padding and misaligned rows); raw `<h2>`/`<h3>` instead of `<Heading>`; hand-built dropdowns instead of `ActionMenu`.
statement: In dashboard sections, a section `Container` must not omit `p-0`, raw `<h2>`/`<h3>` must not replace `<Heading>`, and dropdowns must not be hand-built instead of `ActionMenu`.

quote: nest a raw modal inside another (use `StackedFocusModal` / `StackedDrawer`).
statement: In dashboard UI, a modal opened inside a route modal must use `StackedFocusModal` / `StackedDrawer`, not a nested raw modal.

quote: No arbitrary spacing values where the scale has one (`gap-y-3/4/8`, `px-6 py-4`, `p-16`).
statement: In dashboard UI, arbitrary spacing values must not be used where the scale has a value.

quote: Every visible string via `useTranslation()` / `t(key)`. No literal UI strings.
statement: In dashboard UI, every visible string must use `t(key)`; literal UI strings are not allowed.

quote: `kit.mjs` | The drawing kit. Tokens for both themes, every primitive. **Do not add colours or sizes outside it.**
statement: In docs figure sources (apps/docs/figures/*.mjs), colours and sizes must not be defined outside `.claude/skills/mercur-figure/kit.mjs`.

quote: `apps/docs/images/figures/*.svg` | Build output, committed. Never hand-edit.
statement: In apps/docs/images/figures/*.svg, files must be build output from `build.mjs` and never hand-edited.

quote: **Write** `apps/docs/figures/<name>.mjs` — `export default { name, width, height, alt, draw(f) }`, using only the kit
statement: In apps/docs/figures/<name>.mjs, the module must `export default { name, width, height, alt, draw(f) }` and draw using only kit primitives.

quote: writing `<rect>`, a hex colour, or a font size in a figure | use the kit; a missing primitive goes into `kit.mjs` with tokens for both themes
statement: In apps/docs/figures/*.mjs, figures must not contain raw `<rect>` markup, hex colours or font sizes; missing primitives go into `kit.mjs`.

quote: Text is never coloured. `build.mjs` warns when violet is used more than four times.
statement: In docs figure sources, text must never be coloured and the violet accent should mark only one place.

quote: **Workflow**: the handler runs a workflow for every write. Each step has a compensation function, so when a step fails, the steps before it roll back.
statement: In API route handlers, every write must run a workflow, and each workflow step must have a compensation function.

quote: **Module**: workflow steps call module services. A module owns its tables and never imports another module.
statement: In modules, a module must never import another module; module services are called from workflow steps.

quote: Links record relationships between modules without foreign keys between their tables.
statement: In module models, relationships between modules must not use foreign keys between their tables; they must be recorded as links.

quote: Reads skip the workflow layer. Handlers call Medusa’s [Query](https://docs.medusajs.com/learn/fundamentals/module-links/query), which follows links across modules in one call.
statement: In API route handlers, reads must use Medusa Query (`query.graph`) rather than workflows or cross-module service calls.

quote: A payout provider implements `IPayoutProvider` from `@mercurjs/types`, which has four methods: `createPayoutAccount`, `createOnboarding`, `createPayout`, and `getWebhookActionAndData`.
statement: In payout providers, the provider must implement `IPayoutProvider` from `@mercurjs/types` (`createPayoutAccount`, `createOnboarding`, `createPayout`, `getWebhookActionAndData`).

quote: Call these APIs with the typed `@mercurjs/client`. Every route below maps 1:1 to a client call.
statement: In clients of the Mercur API (panels, storefront, integrations), calls should use the typed `@mercurjs/client`.

quote: Prefix every entry with `+` or `-` when you mean to merge.
statement: In `fields` query parameters meant to merge with route defaults, every entry must be prefixed with `+` or `-`.

quote: Errors follow Medusa's format:
statement: In Mercur API routes, errors must follow Medusa's `{ type, message }` format (thrown as `MedusaError` types such as `invalid_data`, `not_allowed`, `not_found`).

quote: A layer may only talk to the layer directly beneath it.
statement: In backend and frontend code, each layer (Frontend -> API Route -> Workflow -> Module) may only call the layer directly beneath it.

quote: **All mutations go through a workflow.** Never write to the database directly from an API route, a subscriber, or a scheduled job.
statement: In API routes, subscribers and scheduled jobs, code must not write to the database directly; all mutations must run a workflow.

quote: **Only `GET`, `POST`, and `DELETE`.** Mercur (following Medusa) does not use `PUT` or `PATCH`. Updates are modeled as `POST` to the resource.
statement: In API `route.ts` files, only `GET`, `POST` and `DELETE` handlers may be exported; `PUT` and `PATCH` must not be used.

quote: **No cross-module service calls.** A module service must never import or call another module's service.
statement: In module services, code must never import or call another module's service.

quote: **Modules are thin.** A module service is CRUD plus small, self-contained helpers. If a method touches more than one module's data, it belongs in a workflow, not the service.
statement: In module services, methods must not touch more than one module's data; such logic belongs in a workflow.

quote: **One mutation per step.** Each workflow step performs a single mutation and defines how to compensate it.
statement: In workflow steps, each step must perform a single mutation and define its compensation.

quote: | **Input shape / type validation** | API route (Zod schema on the request) | Module service, workflow |
statement: In backend code, input shape validation must be done with Zod schemas at the API route, not in module services or workflows.

quote: | **Emitting domain events** | Workflow step (`emitEventStep`) | Module service, subscriber |
statement: In backend code, domain events must be emitted from workflow steps (`emitEventStep`), not from module services or subscribers.

quote: | **Response shaping / field selection** | API route `queryConfig` (fields) | The module service |
statement: In backend code, response field selection must be defined in the API route `queryConfig`, not in the module service.

quote: | **Reacting to something that happened** (emails, sync, indexing) | Subscriber (listens to an event, runs a workflow) | Inline inside the route that caused it |
statement: In API routes, side effects reacting to an event (emails, sync, indexing) must not be inlined; they belong in a subscriber that runs a workflow, and periodic work in a scheduled job.

quote: Don't leave `MedusaResponse` bare.
statement: In API route handlers, the request must be typed `AuthenticatedMedusaRequest<TBodyOrQuery>` and the response `MedusaResponse<TResponse>`; a bare `MedusaResponse` must not be used.

quote: Validation happens in `middlewares.ts` via `validateAndTransformBody` / `validateAndTransformQuery`. Every schema exports its inferred type so the handler generic and the SDK share one source of truth.
statement: In API routes, validation must be wired in `middlewares.ts` via `validateAndTransformBody` / `validateAndTransformQuery`, and every Zod schema in `validators.ts` must export its `z.infer` type.

quote: List and read params use the framework helpers `createFindParams` (pagination, `fields`, and `order`) and `createSelectParams` (retrieve) rather than a hand-rolled object.
statement: In API validators, list query params must use `createFindParams` and retrieve params `createSelectParams`, not hand-rolled objects.

quote: The handler then trusts `req.validatedBody` and the validated query to already match those types. Never re-validate inside the handler.
statement: In API route handlers, input must be read from `req.validatedBody` / validated query and must not be re-validated inside the handler.

quote: To scope a request you inject onto `req.filterableFields` in middleware (next section). The handler never builds a `where` clause by hand.
statement: In API route handlers, filters must be forwarded from `req.filterableFields`; handlers must not build `where` clauses by hand, and scoping filters are injected by middleware.

quote: You can only filter this way on a field that belongs to the entity's own module. Filtering by a linked module's field (e.g. products by their `brand`) does not work with `query.graph`.
statement: In backend queries, `query.graph` filters must only use fields of the entity's own module; cross-module filters must use `query.index`.

quote: Don't re-derive or re-check identity inside handlers, and don't read user or owner ids from the request body. Always take them from `req.auth_context` (or a context object a scoping middleware populated).
statement: In API route handlers, actor identity must be read from `req.auth_context` (or a scoping middleware's context) and must not be read from the request body or re-checked in the handler.

quote: Never take a `seller_id` from the request body or query to decide ownership. That's caller-supplied. The only authoritative seller is `req.seller_context.seller_id`.
statement: In `/vendor/*` route handlers, ownership must be decided from `req.seller_context.seller_id`, never a `seller_id` from body or query; list routes must be scoped with the `filterBySellerId()` middleware.

quote: **`fields` replaces defaults unless prefixed.** An unprefixed field in the request's `fields` param *replaces* the route's default set.
statement: In API query configs, default fields must be declared in `query-config.ts` (`list` / `retrieve`), and requested extra fields must be `+`/`-` prefixed.

quote: Declare the response shapes next to the route (or in `@mercurjs/types` for shared ones) and use them as the `MedusaResponse` generic.
statement: In API routes, response shapes must be declared next to the route (`types.ts`) or in `@mercurjs/types` and used as the `MedusaResponse` generic.

quote: Extend `MedusaService({ ...models })` and you get typed `list`, `listAndCount`, `retrieve`, `create`, `update`, and `delete` methods for every model for free. Use them.
statement: In module services, the class must extend `MedusaService({ ...models })` and use the generated CRUD methods rather than custom equivalents.

quote: Some logic must never live in a module service: business orchestration, calls to another module's service, event emission, HTTP concerns, or anything that mutates data outside this module.
statement: In module services, code must not contain business orchestration, calls to another module's service, event emission, HTTP concerns, or mutations outside its own module.

quote: **Register the module by a stable id constant.** Export the module id and register the service against it:
statement: In module `index.ts`, the module id must be an exported constant (e.g. `BRAND_MODULE`) used in `Module(ID, { service })`; the raw id string must not be inlined in more than one place.

quote: **Methods are `camelCase` and model-suffixed.** Medusa generates `listBrands`, `createBrands`, and `retrieveBrand`. Match that casing and pluralisation when you add or override methods. Private helpers end with a trailing underscore (`computeBrandStats_`).
statement: In module services, methods must be camelCase and model-suffixed matching Medusa pluralisation, and private helpers must end with a trailing underscore.

quote: **Models are lowercase-defined, referenced by their key.** `model.define("brand", { ... })`.
statement: In module models, `model.define` must use a lowercase snake name (e.g. `model.define("brand", ...)`).

quote: **Types live next to the module, or in a shared types package.** Export DTOs such as `BrandDTO` and import them. Never redeclare a model's shape ad hoc.
statement: In backend code, model DTOs must be exported (next to the module or in a shared types package) and imported; a model's shape must never be redeclared ad hoc.

quote: A module never imports another module's `.linkable` shape to build a foreign key into it.
statement: In module models, code must not import another module's `.linkable` or add cross-module foreign keys; models stay flat with plain columns.

quote: | `@InjectManager()` | Read methods | Injects the entity manager so the method runs in the current context. |
statement: In module services, custom read methods must use `@InjectManager()`, custom write methods `@InjectTransactionManager()`, and the trailing `sharedContext` parameter `@MedusaContext()`.

quote: Declared in its own file under `src/links/`, using `defineLink`.
statement: In backend code, each module link must be declared in its own file under `src/links/` with `defineLink`.

quote: For a many-to-many relationship, where a product can carry many brands and a brand spans many products, mark both sides as lists and pin an explicit table name:
statement: In link definitions, the many side must be wrapped as `{ linkable, isList: true }`; many-to-many links must mark both sides `isList` and set an explicit `database.table` name.

quote: It must happen inside a [workflow](/rc/resources/best-practices/workflows) through the built-in link steps. Never write to the link table directly.
statement: In backend code, links must be created/removed only inside workflows with `createRemoteLinkStep` / `dismissRemoteLinkStep`; link tables must never be written directly.

quote: Build the link definitions with `transform` (never inline logic in the composition function), then pass them to the step.
statement: In workflows, link definitions passed to `createRemoteLinkStep` must be built inside `transform`.

quote: `query.graph` cannot filter by a linked (cross-module) field.
statement: In backend queries, filters on linked (cross-module) fields must use `query.index` (Index Module), not `query.graph`.

quote: use `async` / `await`
statement: In `createWorkflow` composition functions, `async`/`await` must not be used.

quote: use arrow functions for the composition body (use a named `function`)
statement: In `createWorkflow` calls, the composition body must be a `function` expression, not an arrow function.

quote: use `if` / `else`, `for`, `while`, or `try/catch`
statement: In `createWorkflow` composition functions, `if`/`else`, `for`, `while` and `try/catch` must not be used; use `when` and `transform`.

quote: use `new Date()`, `Math.random()`, or any non-deterministic call
statement: In `createWorkflow` composition functions, `new Date()`, `Math.random()` and other non-deterministic calls must not be used; put them inside a step.

quote: access properties of a step's output directly (e.g. `result.id`)
